ibmhw_announcements.body: Please place questions in the closest section, use descriptive subjects, and search recent messages before posting.

ibmhw_rules.author: SYSOP
ibmhw_rules.subject: Forum instructions
ibmhw_rules.body: Messages are public. Be courteous, quote only what is needed, and do not upload copyrighted commercial software. Use the Libraries area for public-domain and shareware files.
